name: grunt
description: Grunt charts and tables: Grunt's MCP server and skills for charts and tables inside PowerPoint (powerpoint), in .pptx files built outside PowerPoint (pptx) and in interactive HTML reports (html). Sign in with your own Grunt account.

interface.shortDescription: Grunt charts in HTML reports and PowerPoint decks
interface.longDescription: Create Grunt charts and tables with the Grunt MCP server that comes with the plugin, then place them on slides inside PowerPoint (powerpoint), in .pptx files built outside PowerPoint (pptx) or in interactive, self-contained HTML reports (html). Sign in with your own Grunt account.
defaultPrompt: Create a Grunt bar chart of quarterly revenue by region and put it on slide 2 of deck.pptx.
